titulo_original: Sinfonía del viaje a la luna

sinopsis.es: Nicolás es un niño que cree que, cuando su abuela muere, se va a la luna. Por eso empieza a crear muchos artefactos para viajar hasta allá y volver a verla. Sin embargo, todos sus inventos fallan, y su padre intenta hacer realidad su sueño.
sinopsis.en: Nicolás is a little kid who thinks that when his grandmother dies, she goes to the moon. Therefore, he begins to create a lot of artifacts to travel to the moon to see her again. However, he fails in all his inventions and his father tries to make his dream come true.
